title: Augmenting Bias Detection in LLMs Using Topological Data Analysis
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures stereotypical bias related to religion by analyzing the internal attention mechanisms of a large language model when processing sentences containing stereotypes, anti-stereotypes, and irrelevant continuations for specific religious groups.
findings: While on average there was no significant misrepresentation for the religion category as a whole, the proposed metric identified differences between subgroups. Specifically, the representations for 'Brahmin' and 'Muslim' were found to be more negative compared to the representation for 'Bible'. The study also identified specific attention heads in GPT-2 that act as 'hot spots' for processing religious bias.
